description: Rate an answer that was accepted automatically (or accepted without a rating): 1-5 stars, ticked tags, an optional comment. Open for 14 days after acceptance, once per request. It counts toward the helper's reputation.

public_comment.description: Show your comment on the helper's public profile.

token.description: Optional API key (zck_...), session token or guest requester_token for this call only. Overrides the connection's Authorization header. Use it to follow up on a request you posted as a guest.

name: review_answer
title: Review an accepted answer
